title: Moordown Halifax Memorial
crew_summary: 7 aircrew killed; 2 civilians killed; 4 cottages destroyed

external_narratives.summary: Dedicated memorial website for Halifax JP137. The aircraft took off from Hurn Aerodrome shortly after 0100 on 21 March 1944 and experienced a serious engine malfunction within the first few minutes of flight. The pilot, 20-year-old Denis Evans, turned to head back following Wimborne Road while flying precariously low. Official reports blamed the pilot, but it is now believed a known Halifax design issue was the primary cause.
key_details: Known Halifax design fault now believed to be cause
Official report blamed pilot despite eyewitness accounts of engine failure

Name: Handley Page Halifax JP137
Type: Stone of remembrance

Inscription: MOORDOWN/ HALIFAX MEMORIAL/ IN MEMORY OF THE TWO LOCAL RESIDENTS/AND SEVEN AIRCREW WHO LOST THEIR LIVES/ IN THE CAUSE OF FREEDOM/ WHEN RAF HALIFAX BOMBER JP 137 CRASHED/ AT THIS LOCATION ON 21st MARCH 1944./ [crew names inscribed on memorial]/ 'LEST WE FORGET'/ ORGANISED BY THE MOORTOWN 2010 COMMITTEE/ AS A CONTRIBUTION TO THE BICENTENARY OF BOURNEMOUTH.
Location: Wimborne Road Moordown Bournemouth Dorset BH9 2BU England

Photos: https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/10/203/moordown_halifax_memorial_croger_shore.jpg; https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/40/446/large_66526_mark_newton__3_march_2016.jpg

Memorial Unveiling (3 March 2016): Unveiling of the Handley Page Halifax JP137 memorial by Mark Newton.
narrative: Halifax JP137, operating from Hurn with No. 3 Overseas Aircraft Dispatch Unit, came down over the residential district of Moordown, Bournemouth, on 21 March 1944. All seven aircrew aboard were killed: George Alexander, Stanley Appleton, Denis Evans, Stanley Gent, Kenneth Green, Reginald Mcgregor, and Henry Roberts. The aircraft struck the surrounding area with devastating force, destroying four cottages and claiming the lives of two local civilians. Nine people in total died as a result of the crash. A memorial at Moordown was dedicated in 2011 to honour all nine victims.

MOORDOWN
HALIFAX MEMORIAL
